source.source_crs: Saved identity query is EPSG:4326; native service geometry was also captured in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857)
source.measurement_method: Plan coordinates transformed with the modular project's documented local degrees-to-meters approximation. Native EPSG:3857 ring shoelace area independently reconciles with Shape__Area; local ground-scale area differs because Web Mercator area includes latitude distortion.
source.identity_evidence: GIS feature name William H. Daniel Turfgrass Research & Diagnostic Court, abbreviation DANL, address 1340 Cherry Lane; outline overlays the long building roof in Esri World Imagery. A 2011 turf-industry visit account explicitly labels its attached exterior photo as the Daniel Center building.
source_conflicts: The stale assignment_queue screening links FID 855, which the campus index identifies as the Old Purdue Exponent Building; this candidate was rejected. Named Purdue GIS FID 208 at 1340 Cherry Lane is used instead.
Turf Recreation Exercise Center (TREC) is a separate RecWell facility; this model uses the outdoor-research Daniel Center's DANL/FID 208 identity and footprint.

Native EPSG:3857 ring shoelace area=1170.6289 m2 matches Shape__Area=1170.6211 m2 within 0.0078 m2. The earlier apparent mismatch compared distorted Web Mercator area with a latitude-corrected local ground projection.

The ring appears to follow the roof projection in aerial imagery; a surveyed wall line/overhang offset was not located, so the model records that limitation rather than treating it as a measured wall boundary.
GIS Extrution=14 has undocumented units and is not used as a height. Vertical scale is a low-confidence visual estimate because no measured elevation or height source was found.
The Purdue expansion flyer and Synthesis feasibility renderings describe proposed changes and were excluded as evidence of as-built form.

The attributed 2011 exterior photo supports pale metal cladding, a long window band, and a centered canopy. The long facade is assigned to the south side by matching the photo's central entrance to the centered south GIS roof-outline bump and the parking apron in the north-up aerial; the photograph has no compass heading, so this orientation remains an inference.
source.uncertainty: GIS footprint is roof-projection-like in the orthophoto; surveyed wall line and eave overhang are unavailable. Exterior photo directly supports pale metal siding, a long window band, centered entrance canopy, and shallow gable, but supplies no dimensions or compass heading. South-facing facade mapping is inferred by matching the centered photo entrance/canopy to the centered south GIS projection bump and the parking apron in the north-up aerial. Window band position and canopy Z dimensions are visual estimates; exact roof pitch and eave/ridge heights remain unmeasured, low-confidence visual estimates.

gis.official_name: William H. Daniel Turfgrass Research & Diagnostic Court

model.footprint: Exact FID 208 plan extent retained in campus-world coordinates; main wall outline bridges the centered south projection bump and centered canopy restores its exact outer plan extent
model.roof: Shallow gable supported by a Daniel Center exterior photo; pitch and absolute vertical scale unmeasured
